say:2:1122206001:1.text: Whatever you want, you've got the wrong guy.
say:2:1122206001:1.source_cn: 我不认识你，你找错人了。
say:2:1122206001:1.male: Whatever you want, you've got the wrong guy.
say:2:1122206001:1.female: Whatever you want, you've got the wrong guy.

say:3:1122206002:1.text: Good sir, we're just walking around! We're interested in talking to people nearby about this town.
say:3:1122206002:1.source_cn: 这位大叔，你别生气，最近镇上不太平，我们只是想来打听一些事。

say:4:1122206003:1.text: You wanna talk to me? Well, I'm new to Alkali so I don't know bull!
say:4:1122206003:1.source_cn: 和我打听？我刚来咸水镇没多久，什么都不知道！

say:8:1122206005:1.text: What odd behavior, I bet he's hiding something!
say:8:1122206005:1.source_cn: 他表现得好反常，肯定隐瞒着什么事。

say:9:1122206006:1.text: Guess Cyril was telling the truth. Magister, we can't let down our guards and blow our cover!
say:9:1122206006:1.source_cn: 看来枪械店老板说的是真的。主人，接下来我们得更加小心，...
say:9:1122206006:1.male: Guess Cyril was telling the truth. Magister, we can't let down our guards and blow our cover!
say:9:1122206006:1.female: Guess Cyril was telling the truth. Magister, we can't let down our guards and blow our cover!

say:12:1122206007:1.text: Are you done whispering? Go on, shoo!
say:12:1122206007:1.source_cn: 喂，你们聊完了没有？别挡着我吹风了！

choice:13:1:2.text: You hear about any bandits lately?
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 你认识最近出没的那伙盗匪吧
